blurb: This check verifies that /usr/bin/rcp, /usr/bin/rlogin, /usr/bin/rsh, /usr/bin/rexec and /usr/bin/telnet are mode 0000 (----------) or absent. Those programs are the legacy rcmd and telnet clients; if they remain executable a user on this host can start a cleartext remote login or remote command that exposes credentials and session data.
